title: Decision: keyMaterial requests from a did_webvh room require did_webvh and did_webvh_heads; mimi-mls stays the only writer of the GroupContext required_capabilities
description:
Two rules meet. Decision mimid-1wgh.4.33 leaves required_capabilities to the protocol layer (mimi-mls Member::create sets none). Decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.16 narrows it: for did_webvh groups mimi-mls itself puts did_webvh_heads and did_webvh into the GroupContext's required_capabilities, as draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-01 §The Heads Extension requires, keeping whatever else is listed. The protocol layer's own use of RequiredCapabilities is in protocol-07 §5.2 keyMaterial: the requester lists what the room needs, so the target provider returns only KeyPackages that can join (§4.3.1: "the requester includes the list of RequiredCapabilites to ensure the new joiner is compatible").

Is there a conflict? The agent's KeyMaterial requests carried a constant (app_data_dictionary, AppDataUpdate, no credential types), so in a did_webvh room a provider could return a KeyPackage of a client that does not list did_webvh, which the Commit then cannot add (RFC 9420 §7.2; OpenMLS UnsupportedCredentials).

Readings: (a) leave the request constant; the Commit fails late. (b) send the GroupContext's whole required_capabilities. (c) send mimid's constant plus, when the group carries did_webvh_heads, did_webvh_heads in extension_types and did_webvh in credential_types.

Chosen: (c). It keeps decision mimid-1wgh.4.33 for everything else (mimid's rooms carry no other required_capabilities), keeps mimi-mls the only writer of the GroupContext extension (mimid-1wgh.4.81.16), and makes the keyMaterial request say what the room's own required_capabilities says about did_webvh. A room whose record is not set yet (Basic members only) asks for nothing more; adding the first did_webvh user then works because a did_webvh KeyPackage lists did_webvh anyway. No change to mimid-server: it already filters with VerifiedKeyPackageInfo::satisfies.
